market_question: Will Solana dip to $20 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Solana has historically experienced 90%+ drawdowns during bear markets (e.g., from $260 to ~$8). With the timeframe covering 20 months, a full bear cycle could materialize, making an 85% drop to $20 plausible. The market's 9.5% price underestimates this tail risk; I estimate true probability around 15%.
evidence_points: SOL drew down 97% from ATH in 2022, hitting single-digit prices.
Crypto bull-bear cycles often see peak-to-trough declines >80% for altcoins.
Current timeframe (Nov 2025–Dec 2026) encompasses a likely post-halving bear phase.
